calculation_steps: Difference of Mahalanobis squared errors is Delta=2 delta^T Sigma^-1(Y-mu0)-d2.
Under H0/H1, Delta has means minus/plus d2 and variance 4d2.
At size alpha, threshold=-d2+2d z_(1-alpha); H1 power=Phi(d-z_(1-alpha)).
At alpha=1/20 and power=4/5, d required is z_.95+z_.80 approximately 2.4864748605.
Synthetic fixture yields exact d2=4/3 and midpoint Delta=0.

result.approximation: required d≈2.486474860524386 at alpha=.05 and target power=.8
result.units: d and Delta dimensionless after covariance metric
result.precision_and_error: rational fixture exact; standard library double Gaussian tail
result.scope: two fixed Gaussian simple hypotheses, common SPD covariance, uncensored registered signed forces
result.physical_interpretation: conditional study design only, no UD friction prediction

verification.method: analytic likelihood identity and synthetic exact replay

counterexamples_and_failures: If d2=0 the hypotheses coincide; no discrimination.
Changing covariance after seeing force traces invalidates nominal size.
Treating non-detections as zero force violates this likelihood.
limitations: No actual mu1, Sigma or measured signed force.
Shared Gaussian covariance may fail for drift, censoring or nuisance calibration.
No non-constructor adversarial review or preregistered physical test.
next_discriminant: Freeze sourced model and covariance before acquiring new force traces, then execute a blinded test.
